name: Brookview House
address: Brookview House, Balcunnin, Skerries, Co. Dublin
agent: John Cumisky, Sherry FitzGerald Cumisky Kelly, Balbriggan
bedsNote: listed as 4/5 bed; office could be a 5th, and there is a finished bedroom and study whose location isn't stated
heating: Geothermal heat pump (house); air-to-water heat pump (barn)
tagline: A large modern A3 house on 3.14 acres off the Baldongan Road, 2 km from Skerries station, between vegetable fields and a farmyard.

pros.detail: Skerries station is 2.0 km by the listing; about 30 southbound departures a weekday on the Northern Commuter line, roughly 38–44 minutes to Connolly.

pros.text: 3.14 acres, private and fenced by hedges
pros.detail: Electric gates, a long tree-lined drive, open lawns and mature planting; plenty of room for the dogs.
68.93 kWh/m²/yr; low running costs and no retrofit bill, which few houses on the list can say.
Three ensuite shower rooms plus a family bathroom upstairs, a ground-floor shower room at the rear and a guest WC.
Living room 6.8 × 4.86 m, family room 6.34 × 6.6 m with a stove, kitchen 4.73 × 5.9 m and dining 6.3 × 5.1 m, plus a 3.95 × 4.48 m office.

pros.text: Barn with its own heat pump
pros.detail: A large insulated barn set apart from the house with air-to-water heating; a possible annex for the parents or a letting unit, subject to planning.
Milverton NS is 710 m away (listing); Skerries Community College 2.6 km; 75–85% progression to third level.
Via the M1 from Lusk; the airport trip the family will make most is short.

cons.detail: €3,796/m²; stamp duty about €19,000. On Daft since 9 Oct 2025 (over a year, 42.8k views) and on MyHome since 30 Jul 2025 with no price change shown: leverage to negotiate.

cons.text: Farmyard and vegetable fields on both sides
cons.detail: The aerials show a large yard of agricultural sheds, polytunnels and a car park directly east along the drive, and commercial brassica fields hard against the west hedge. Expect tractors, spraying and early starts.

cons.text: Ground-floor bedroom not on the floor plan
cons.detail: The text promises a rear ground-floor bedroom with ensuite shower, but the published plan shows all four bedrooms upstairs and only a laundry, entry and shower room at the rear.
Double-height hall and a long first-floor landing; the parents would be climbing stairs unless the barn or the office is converted.
Rural site off the Baldongan Road; the listing doesn't say mains water or septic. BuyerIQ flags one environmental factor and 10 planning applications within 1 km, details paywalled.
A 'gently flowing stream' runs beside the driveway; worth fencing for two small boys and checking for flood history.
Poles and lines cross the front of the site by the road in the drive photos.

questions: The description mentions a ground-floor bedroom with ensuite shower to the rear, but the floor plan shows all four bedrooms upstairs. Where is that room, and is the newer bedroom and study in photos 49–52 in the house or the barn?
What is the barn's floor area, is it plumbed, and does it have planning permission for habitable or ancillary family use?

What business runs the yard next to the drive, and what goes on there day to day (machinery, packing, deliveries, hours)? Are any of the 10 planning applications within 1 km for that yard or the fields beside the house?
Is the house on mains water and sewer, or a well and septic tank or treatment plant? Has the stream by the drive ever flooded?
The house has been on the market since summer 2025 with no change in price shown. Has the asking price been revised, and is there room to move?

ai.why: Big, A3-efficient and on 3 acres, 2 km from a Dublin train. But at €1.45m it is three times the budget, a farmyard and commercial fields sit hard on both sides, and the floor plan puts every bedroom upstairs.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house runs two heat pumps and electric gates.

water.detail: Not stated in the listing; rural site, could be mains or a well. Ask.

sewer.detail: Not stated; likely a septic tank or treatment plant on a 3-acre rural site. Ask for certification.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband — 406 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The listing says there's a rear ground-floor bedroom with ensuite shower, but the floor plan shows none; the 3.95 × 4.48 m office beside a ground-floor bathroom, or the heated barn, are the fallbacks.
